name: Mihika Industries Limited
about: Mihika Industries Limited engages in the trading and distribution of commodities and fabrics in India. It also trades in agriculture goods and materials, as well as involved in the commission agents and investment businesses. The company was formerly known as Ashish Vanijya Pratishthan Limited and changed its name to Mihika Industries Limited on May 05, 1995. Mihika Industries Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
